headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, large quotes. Use tracking-tight.

body.usage: Paragraphs, navigation, buttons, small labels. Use tracking-normal to wide.

layout.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 to py-32 for sections. Gap-12 to gap-16 for grids.
layout.grid_strategy: Mobile-first single column. On desktop, use asymmetric overlapping bento layouts or 'The Swiss Grid' with wide gaps.
layout.container: Max-width 7xl (max-w-7xl) with px-6 or px-8 padding.
layout.radius: Organic and soft. Use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for images. Buttons can be fully rounded (rounded-full) or softly rounded (rounded-lg).

surfaces_and_textures.hero_overlay: bg-[#4A5D4E]/20 to bg-[#2B2E2A]/30 for text readability without obscuring the organic texture.
surfaces_and_textures.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F4F1ED]/80 border-b border-[#4A5D4E]/10. Use for sticky header.
surfaces_and_textures.cards: Cardless or flat background with no shadow. Instead of standard cards, use solid backgrounds (#FFFFFF) with generous padding (p-8 to p-12) and subtle 1px border (#4A5D4E/10).

animations.hover: Subtle translate-y-1, opacity shifts, and slow transitions (duration-300 ease-out).
animations.interactive: Buttons should have a gentle scale effect on active state.

components.navigation: Sticky top, glassmorphism background. Multilingual toggle (EN/DE/IT/PT) represented as clean text or rounded flags. CTA prominently aligned right.
components.hero: Immersive image background. Center-aligned text for tranquility. Large serif H1, wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle.
components.about_section: Asymmetric split. Left: Large softly rounded portrait image. Right: Typography-focused story about Lalo's touch and empathy.
components.sessions_section: List or alternating grid. Avoid rigid cards. Use horizontal dividing lines (border-t) and large padding to separate 'Thai Massage', 'Alexander Technique', and 'Body Awareness'.
components.testimonials: Shadcn Carousel. Minimalist design. Large serif quotation mark in muted turquoise (#5E8B82).
components.contact: Clean Shadcn Form customized with flat inputs (border-b only, or soft solid backgrounds). High-contrast primary CTA button.
components.footer: Dark or highly contrasted background (#2B2E2A) with light text (#F4F1ED) to ground the page. Large typography for the German tagline.

images.description: Green moss on a woven basket - evocative of organic earth tones and texture.
Smiling man with a beard, natural warm and welcoming presence for Lalo's bio.
Minimalist composition with a leaf on overlapping white circular plates - used as the circular Tranquilário logo element.
Subtle natural fabric/stone texture with gentle gradients for section backgrounds.
Hands performing therapy - representing touch and body awareness.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Cormorant Garamond and Manrope from Google Fonts.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Never use pure white #FFFFFF for the main background; use the Warm Sand #F4F1ED to maintain the earthy theme. Use #FFFFFF for localized surface highlights.
Do not use generic Shadcn Cards for the Sessions section. Create a bespoke, airy layout using borders and padding.
Implement a smooth scroll experience (e.g., using Lenis if possible or standard CSS smooth scrolling).
Include the specified testimonials (Jan M., Malina E., etc.) in a sleek carousel.
Build the Language Toggle in the header (EN, DE, IT, PT). You can use simple text or small circular flags.
Ensure the contact form has an earthy, non-corporate feel. Avoid harsh input borders. Use a soft underline (border-b) or softly rounded inputs filled with white.
